book.name: 2 Timoseo
book.title: Balua ja kabheli jaka Paulo kwa Timoseo

content: Ukombuka kubha, mu machobha gha ujomukelu anakubya na chikahi cha mang'ahiku makolongwa.

Maghambu bhandu anabhakubha bha kulipala bheni, bhabhapala mbija, bhabhapala kulilumbalila, bhabhabhi na ing'omu, bhabhuntondola Chapanga, bhangakubhatii bhabheleka bhabhu, bhangakubha na uchengulu, bhangakubha bhahuhu,
bhangakubha na upalu, bhangakupala kujongana, bhabhakopunganela, bhangakulihibhalakila matokuelu ghabhu na bhakale, bhangakupala ghambone,
bhabhang'anambuka bhajabhu, bhabhabhi na ing'omu, bhabhatweli kulibhona, bhabhapala kutama matamu mahakau kuliku kumpala Chapanga.
Kwa kunja bhabhonikana ngati bhandu bhabhunjojabhe Chapanga, nambu bhaghakana makili ghaki. Ulijepaje na bhandu bha ntundu ghonihoghu.

Bhakumu bhabhu bhajenda mu nyumba ya bhandu na kubhakolowa akambomba bhang'ang'a nahuli bhabhajowanya bhombe, akambomba bhabhabhi na hibwahila ya mahoku na kulonguheka na ntundu wokapi wa utokulelu uhakau.
Akambomba bhanihabha bhalibhola machobha ghokapi, nambu ngachebhaweza kuuhikila umanyi wa chakaka ng'o.

Bhandu bhanihabha bhaukaniki uchakaka ngati Yane na Yamble mobhakumpengi Musa, bhelabhela bhandu bhanihabha bhapengana na chakaka jela. Bhanihabha nde bhandu bhabhabhi na malangu ghaghayonangiki, na bhakanakiki kwa mambu gha uhobhalelu.
Nambu ngabhawezi kujendalela nakanopi maghambu ung'ang'a wabhu anaubhonikana palanga ja bhandu bhokapi. Nde mokukabheli kwaka Yane na Yamble.
Nambu wehapa wa Timoseo, ughajengalyaje mabholu ghangu, na ntundu mondamila, na chembalikaje mu matamu ghangu, uhobhalelu wangu, uhinakalilu wangu, upalu wangu, na kulendalela kwangu,
mang'ahiku na kulagha. Ughamanyi mambu ghaghambatiki ku muchi wa ku Antiokia, ku Ikonio na ku Listila hoku. Nakahinaki mang'ahiku ghokapi nambu Bambo akangengalili mu ghanihagha ghokapi.
Kila mundu joapala kutama matamu gha uhuhu mu kulombana na Kristo Yesu anang'ahikaje,
nambu bhandu bhahakau na bhabhakolowa anabhapetalyaje kubha bhahakau, bhakakoluwaji na koni bheni bhakoluweka.
Nambu wehapa utamaje mu uchakaka ghola ghoukalibholiki na kuhobhalela nakanope. Kwa ndandi ubhamanyi bhala bhabhukubholike,
nanau ukombukaje kutumbu umwana waku ughamanyi Malembu Mahuhu ambaghu ghaweza kukupekeha mbulau nahuli ukengaliwaje kwa indela ja uhobhalelu kwaka Kristo Yesu.
Kila lilembu lelibhi na mbomu jaka Chapanga lilenganela mu kubholela uchakaka, kulakalila na kubhalangiha bhandu mahakau ghabhu, na kubhalongoha bhatamaje mu matamu ghamboni,
nahuli mundu waka Chapanga abya na kila chindu chechipalika kwa kuntumaki jombi, nahuli apata kutenda kila lihengu lamboni.
